CP_WELL_TRIGGER: Sa aitasid kaevu lahti hoida aastal {OLDEST}.
You helped keep the well open in {OLDEST}.
CP_WELL_EFFECT: Kaev jäi. Hilisematel aastatel on talul oma vesi.
The well stayed. In the later years the farm has its own water.
EX_WELL_OPEN: Pooleli kaev. Käsk on see täis ajada. Keegi ei taha.
A half-dug well. The order is to fill it in. Nobody wants to.
EX_WELL_KEPT: Kiviring. Vesi on all, külm ja magus.
A ring of stones. The water is down there, cold and sweet.
EX_WELL_DIP: Lohk maapinnas. Siin oli kord kaev.
A dip in the ground. There was a well here once.

trigger: + { not flag("{FLAG}") } [Miks kaev täis aetakse? %% Why fill the well?]
Sest käsk on nii. Mõisa kaev teenib, öeldakse. Keda teenib. # en: Because the order says so. The manor's well will serve, they say. Serve whom.
Kui keegi aitaks kivid paika tõsta, ei saaks seda enam täita. # en: If somebody helped set the stones, it could not be filled any more.
later: + { flag("{FLAG}") } [Kaev on veel alles. %% The well is still here.]
Magus vesi. Vanad ütlesid, et see oleks peaaegu täis aetud. Keegi aitas. # en: Sweet water. The old people said it was nearly filled in. Somebody helped.
knot: Kivid on kuhjas. Kaevaja vaatab sind. # en: The stones lie in a heap. The digger looks at you.
+ [Aita kivid paika. %% Help set the stones.]
Pool päeva. Käed on marraskil. Ring on kinni. # en: Half a day. Hands raw. The ring is closed.
Kaevaja pöörab selja. # en: The digger turns away.
